common.pageErrorBody: Something failed while loading this page. Your questions and dashboards are safe. Try again.

home.title: Analytics
home.description: Ask questions about your data and put the answers on dashboards.
home.emptyBody: Start with a question about your CRM, Track, Books, Groups or Pulse data, or connect a database in Data.
home.name: Name
home.deleteCollectionBody: Its questions and dashboards move up one level. Nothing inside is deleted.
home.deleteItemBody: This cannot be undone. Dashboards lose the cards that show it.

ask.label: Ask a question about your data
ask.placeholder: Ask in plain words, like “new deals per month this year”
ask.unavailable: Asking in plain words needs AI, which is off in this workspace.

errors.schema: The tables of this source did not load.
errors.not_found: It no longer exists or you cannot see it.
errors.query_timeout: The query took too long and was stopped. Add filters or a limit.
errors.busy: Too many queries are running. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.sql_must_start_with_select: The query has to start with SELECT or WITH.
errors.sql_multiple_statements: Write a single query, without a second statement after a semicolon.
errors.sql_keyword_not_allowed: Only reading is allowed. This word is not:
errors.sql_table_not_allowed: Use the tables listed on the right. This name is not one of them:
errors.sql_too_many_tables: Use at most three tables, joined by their keys.
errors.sql_join_not_allowed: These tables can only be joined by their keys (for example contacts.company_id = companies.id).
errors.sql_join_without_condition: Every join needs ON with the keys, and FROM takes one table.
errors.sql_comments_not_allowed: Remove the comments from the query.
errors.sql_quoted_identifiers_not_allowed: Write table and column names without quotes.
errors.sql_admins_only: Only admins can write SQL on this database. The builder works for everyone.
errors.param_not_number: This variable has to be a number:
errors.param_not_date: This variable has to be a date (YYYY-MM-DD):
errors.join_not_allowed: These tables cannot be joined that way.
errors.filter_value_required: A filter is missing its value.
errors.aggregation_column_required: Pick a column for the metric.
errors.private_host: That address is on a private network and cannot be reached from here.
errors.invalid_host: Check the host: it has to be a name like db.example.com or an IP.
errors.unresolvable_host: That host could not be found.
errors.result_too_large: The result is too large. Add a limit or fewer columns.
errors.recipient_not_member: Emails can only go to people in this workspace.
errors.channel_not_found: That Talk channel does not exist.
errors.talk_not_available: You need Talk to send to a channel.
errors.ai_disabled: AI is off in this workspace.
errors.quota_exceeded: The AI quota for this month is used up.
errors.rate_limited: Too many AI requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.too_many_shares: This already has 5 active links. Turn one off first.
errors.too_many_cards: A dashboard holds up to 40 cards.
errors.too_many_subscriptions: A dashboard holds up to 10 subscriptions.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.param_in_quotes: Put variables where a value goes, without quotes around them.
errors.password_required: Type the password again: it is only reused for the same host, port and user.
errors.database_not_found: That database is no longer connected.

sql.hint: Cmd or Ctrl + Enter runs the query. Variables go as '{{name}}'; wrap optional filters in [[ … ]].
sql.noTables: There are no tables you can read here.

editor.name: Question name
editor.sqlAdminsOnly: Only admins write SQL on this database. Use the builder.
editor.variablesHint: Dashboard filters can fill these variables.
editor.emptyResult: Run the query to see the result.
editor.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Dashboards lose the cards that show it.

share.title: Public link
share.body: Anyone with the link sees the results, calculated with the permissions of the admin who created it. They never see the query.
share.adminOnly: Only admins create or turn off public links.
share.onlyOnce: Copy it now: the full link is shown only once.

dash.emptyBody: Edit it to add saved questions, text and filters.
dash.emptyBodyReadonly: Its owner has not added anything yet.
dash.noQuestions: There are no saved questions yet.
dash.filterHint: After creating it, connect it to each card: a variable of its SQL or a column of the builder.
dash.deleteBody: The dashboard, its subscriptions and its public links are deleted. The questions stay.

subs.title: Subscriptions
subs.body: A summary of this dashboard by email or in a Talk channel, at the hour you pick. It is calculated with the permissions of whoever creates the subscription.
subs.emailHint: Only people in this workspace. Separate addresses with commas.
subs.talkHint: You have to be a member of the channel.

data.title: Data
data.description: What Analytics can read: this workspace and the databases you connect.
data.ownBody: Contacts, companies and deals from CRM, projects and issues from Track, invoices from Books, chats and messages from Groups and events from Pulse. Each person sees only what they can see in each app.
data.readOnlyTip: Use a database user that can only read. Queries run inside a read-only transaction with a time limit, and the password is stored encrypted.
data.name: Name
data.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one
data.deleteBody: Questions that use this database stop working until you connect it again.

public.title: Shared from Analytics
public.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
